academy-story.text: Treat instruction as drama, not as an infographic. Concepts should emerge through questions, mistakes, simulations, historical case action, instrument readouts that characters actively interpret, and consequences. Preserve natural human acting, clear spatial cause-and-effect, and professional integrated lettering. Mirrorfold geometry may be uncanny but must remain legible enough that the reader can follow what the characters think is real, what is reflected, and what changes.

mirrorfold-physics.text: Mirrorfold effects are folded-space optics and echo phenomena, not magic. Reflections may duplicate stars, ships, people, beacons and apparent corridors; sound and active sensing can also return by multiple paths. Physical tethers, inertial history, time-of-flight differences, controlled occlusion and diversified sensor sources can establish which observations share the same path. Avoid random kaleidoscope imagery that destroys navigational logic.
